issues.description: Method SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice: The problem statement explicitly mandates that calculateTotalPrice must be static (shared, using the static stock). The solution implementation defines calculateTotalPrice as an instance method (public int calculateTotalPrice(Meal)), and both the template and solution Main examples call it via an instance (shop.calculateTotalPrice(...)). This mismatch between the specification (static) and the provided code examples/solution (instance) creates confusion for students about whether the method must be declared static and may cause grading or signature-checking mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent. Either (A) update the solution and template call sites to match the problem statement by declaring calculateTotalPrice as static (change signature to public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) and update calls to SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal); or (B) relax the problem statement to allow an instance method and explicitly remove the requirement that calculateTotalPrice be static. Prefer option (A) to match the written requirement: change the method to static in SealSaloon and update any example calls in Main to use the static form.
